subject: hamsters
one_liner: The spreadsheet for everything you put somewhere and immediately forgot.
brand_voice_notes: Dry inventory-software confidence applied to solitary hoarding. Food is capital, cheeks are temporary storage, the wheel produces no revenue. Exact quantities and unnecessary approvals. No winking.

hero.h1: Your cheeks are not a system of record.
hero.sub: Stash gives hamsters a spreadsheet for every seed, hiding place and unexplained shortage. AI reconciles the hoard. You remain the sole source of discrepancies.

features.title: Every seed gets a cell.
features.blurb: Log food by hiding place, edible status and personal attachment. The AI assigns a cost basis to the oat you are saving for an occasion.

features.title: Close the cheek books.
features.blurb: Reconcile left cheek, right cheek and bedding reserves. Anything swallowed without a receipt becomes an unresolved transfer.

features.title: Forecast another identical night.
features.blurb: Turn wheel revolutions into a quarterly growth model. Distance travelled stays at zero. The projection remains encouraging.

demo_screen_concept: An interactive habitat inventory workbook with six food lots across Left cheek, Right cheek and Bedding. Edit seed counts, filter by location, select a row to inspect its own recorded movement or see that none is recorded, and run reconciliation. Initial book stock 42 seeds, physical stock 35, variance -7. Reconciling posts an adjustment and balances the books at 35. Shortage adjustments cite consumed evidence; surplus adjustments cite a rediscovered cache. Add lots in a labelled modal with a matching Now entry in the inspector and transfer log; tabs switch Inventory and Transfer log. All client-side.

design_direction.style: Soft mechanical Swiss modernism: lavender spreadsheet planes, plum oversized grotesk, seed-yellow selection fields, generous gutters and small tactile cell corners.

fonts.pairing: Kinetic Brutalism (Space Grotesk), bundled library; restrained sentence-case adaptation

design_direction.archetype: Interactive Demo + Feature-Rich from bundled library. Product-mechanic hero, large composed campaign art, open feature paragraphs, designed data-story spread, customer evidence and plan comparison.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 160ms color feedback; user-triggered row selection and reconciliation. No ambient animation. Reduced motion disables transitions.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Lavender opening with a large left headline and narrow lower supporting paragraph. A plum workbook tab leads into a broad campaign artwork to the right. Feature text is an open three-column row. Explainer is full width with a live numeric summary below, not tiny embedded data. Pricing uses a joined comparison and mobile stacks. Demo is a dense spreadsheet with editable quantity cells and a transfer inspector.
design_direction.design_review: Read seven latest concepts, including logo/graphic records where present. No tuple matches. Retained interactive product archetype; replaced generic slate/green Inter recommendation with lavender/plum/gold and library Space Grotesk. No neon-on-black, cream serif, generic rounded card grid or decorative numbering. Selected-cell seed motif differs from parcel tabs, lightsticks, film frames, subtraction and vinyl.

brand_kit.identity_rationale: A seed split across two selected spreadsheet cells expresses food storage and the two-cheek reconciliation problem. It creates an original spreadsheet identity without copying Google marks or relying on a hamster mascot. Tabular seed anatomy differs from recent retail folded tabs and fan-club lightsticks.

logo.concept: Selected Gemini direction A: flared split seed with gold interior held inside four spreadsheet-selection corners; bespoke Stash lettering. Direction B rejected: wider double pouch loses clarity at favicon scale. Primary and mono lockups preserve accepted design; icon crops the original symbol.
logo.clear_space: At least half the symbol height around the lockup; included in exports.
logo.placement: Landing navigation and footer; demo chrome; icon favicon on both pages
logo.review: Visually reviewed actual lockup on #EDE7F3 at 220px width, and symbol at 32px and 64px. Plum and gold remain distinct; all selection corners visible. Primary transparent background is real alpha, not checkerboard.

graphic_language.medium: Flat vector-like editorial illustration and deliberate typographic information design in plum, lavender and seed gold.
graphic_language.motif: Split seed in adjacent selected cells; offset cell-selection corners used only at meaningful data boundaries.
graphic_language.composition: Oversized object and tabular cutaways, broad negative space, asymmetric hierarchy. Full compositions preserved with contain sizing.
graphic_language.texture: Fine paper grain inside artwork only; flat CSS surfaces.

tokens.borders: 1px solid var(--line); 2px solid var(--primary) for active cells

graphic_plan.purpose: Campaign composition revealing the elaborate ledger inside a hamster cheek.
Contrast 42 booked seeds with 35 physical seeds and a 7 seed shortage.

images.rationale: Four Gemini calls planned: two competing logo directions, one campaign and one inventory data story. No photography; budget prioritizes identity and two actual graphic-design roles.

items.prompt: Design the actual finished logo for fictional productivity software named exactly 'Stash' (capital S, lowercase tash). It is Google Sheets for hamsters: seeds are inventory, cheeks are storage locations, spreadsheets audit hoarding. Original identity, no Google trademark, no mascot face, no generic rounded-square initials, no mockup or presentation board. Flat solid pale lavender #EDE7F3 background, deep plum #563065 and seed gold #E9BD43. Output one centered horizontal lockup with generous clear space, a distinctive compact symbol on the LEFT and custom legible Stash wordmark on the RIGHT. The symbol must be independently usable at favicon size. Crisp flat vector-like art with no shading, no texture, no other text. Direction A: a single sunflower seed split into two complementary plum lobes, aligned inside two adjacent spreadsheet cell-selection corners. Gold seed interior. Bespoke sturdy grotesk wordmark with a subtle selected-cell cut at the terminal. Avoid excessive internal detail.
items.placement: Landing navigation and footer; demo chrome
items.verdict: Accepted direction A. Correct Stash spelling, strong square silhouette, consistent plum/gold. Direction A has stronger small-size silhouette and a specific cell-selection context. Full wordmark retained with clear space. Export: background removed by color mask, uncropped mark and wordmark, lossless geometry.

items.transformation: Exact same accepted pixels recolored plum, original alpha and proportions.
Crop original symbol from accepted generation, preserve corners and clear space, resize 192px.
items.verdict: Square silhouette retains selection corners and seed.

items.prompt: Create a finished composed graphic artwork for Stash, spreadsheet software for hamsters. Attached image is the APPROVED IDENTITY REFERENCE: preserve its custom Stash lettering, split seed and selection-corner vocabulary if using branding. Use pale lavender #EDE7F3, deep plum #563065, dark #2F1939 and seed gold #E9BD43. Flat editorial illustration, carefully designed typography and information hierarchy, subtle paper grain, no photography, no 3D, no stock mockup. Design the composition yourself. Keep all artwork within generous safe margins, no watermarks, no extra text or gibberish. Purpose: a bold campaign poster for auditing a hamster's hidden reserves. Compose a large stylised hamster cheek cutaway as a softly rounded vault, containing orderly spreadsheet compartments filled with illustrated gold sunflower seeds; a loose seed outside the cheek represents unrecorded inventory. Integrate a large typographic headline, exact text 'Keep your hoard in order.' and a small exact text 'Stash'. Only those two pieces of copy. Left-aligned typographic mass balanced with an oversized cheek cutaway at right; art fills the landscape, do not make a literal app screenshot. Original illustration with personality and sophisticated limited-color graphic design. Main headline must remain large enough to read on mobile.
items.verdict: Accepted. Exact headline and Stash spelling; cheek cutaway, compartment grid and seed illustrations form a composed campaign. Large headline readable at 342px. Full aspect ratio preserved.

items.prompt: The first attached image is the approved Stash identity reference; preserve its plum/lavender/gold visual language. The second image is the EDIT TARGET infographic. Make one targeted correction to that infographic: REMOVE the central dark rectangular label containing 'Unaccounted', fully restore the two seed halves behind it. Keep the bottom '7' and 'Unaccounted for' together. Keep all other typography and composition. Exact complete copy allowed: 'The cheek gap', 'On the books', '42', 'In the habitat', '35', '7', 'Unaccounted for'. Each phrase exactly once. No additional words. Retain the 42 versus 35 = shortage 7 data story, the split spreadsheet/cheek seed, generous safe margins, and high contrast. This is a finished designed infographic, no mockup.
items.initial_prompt: Create a finished composed graphic artwork for Stash, spreadsheet software for hamsters. Attached image is the APPROVED IDENTITY REFERENCE: preserve its custom Stash lettering, split seed and selection-corner vocabulary if using branding. Create a designed editorial composition with a single giant split sunflower seed as the central metaphor: one half as precise spreadsheet cells, the other half as organic cheek storage. Integrate three huge numerical facts and their labels as distinct typographic zones: exact text '42' with 'On the books'; exact text '35' with 'In the habitat'; exact text '7' with 'Unaccounted for'. items.placement: Landing reconciliation spread with live-text equivalent
items.verdict: Accepted targeted correction. Duplicate label removed; exact 42/35/7 figures and required labels verified at full and 342px sizes. Split seed integrates spreadsheet and organic storage. Small title repeated in live HTML.
